title: Rules and categories
intro: Rules assign a category to transactions based on their description. They are tried in order and the first match wins.
loadError: Rules and categories could not be loaded.

rules.heading: Rules
rules.lead: If two rules match a transaction, the one higher up wins. Categories you set by hand are never changed.
rules.emptyText: Create a rule so that transactions with some text in their description always get the same category.
rules.moveError: The order could not be changed. The previous order is kept.
rules.created: Rule “{{pattern}}” created. Press “Apply rules now” to use it on the transactions you already have.
rules.deleteText: The rule “{{pattern}}” will stop applying. Categorised transactions keep their category until you apply the rules again.

ruleForm.patternHint: At least 2 characters. Ignores case and accents and matches whole words: “BAR” does not match “BARCELONA”.
ruleForm.categoryRequired: Choose the category this rule assigns.

preview.tooShort: Type at least 2 characters to see which transactions match.

apply.text: Apply all rules again to your transactions, except the ones you categorised by hand.
apply.error: The rules could not be applied. Please try again.

categories.heading: Categories
categories.rulesDisabled_one: {{count}} rule turned off: it pointed to an archived category
categories.rulesDisabled_other: {{count}} rules turned off: they pointed to an archived category
categories.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
categories.inUseText: Some transactions, rules or budgets use this category, so it cannot be deleted without leaving them orphaned. You can archive it instead: it stops being offered in rules and your data is kept.

categoryForm.name: Name
categoryForm.nameRequired: Type a name for the category.
